title: Fix the Recursion Without a Base Case
description: The program should compute the factorial of a number using recursion.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 120, the factorial of 5.
actualProblem: There is no base case to stop the recursion, so factorial keeps calling itself with smaller and smaller values of n forever, eventually exhausting the call stack and throwing a StackOverflowError.
explanation: Every recursive method needs a base case that stops the recursion once a simplest-case input is reached. Without it, the method never stops calling itself, overflowing the call stack.
